svg.aria-label: Article X(2) has two conditions, not one
svg.text: Article X(2) has two conditions, not one
Is subject to Greek tax in respect of that pension
The condition the article adds, and the one that is left out
Then the UK-source pension is exempt from United Kingdom tax
Residence in Greece alone does not exempt a UK pension from UK tax.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 9 September 2026
